beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It asks which part of confidence comes from the work and which from its surroundings.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That question gives readers a practical distinction without demanding that they abandon expertise.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Credibility can also accumulate through access to resources, collaborators, and further opportunities.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Real achievement may start the process without explaining every advantage that follows.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book examines how feedback can strengthen both productive expertise and institutional closure.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It keeps merit and cumulative advantage in the same picture.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That balance matters because a simple story of corruption would miss ordinary incentives.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers are invited to inspect a system whose participants can behave reasonably within flawed arrangements.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The middle chapters move from reputation toward the work required to challenge a claim.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Review, replication, and correction consume expertise that institutions may reward only weakly.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Competition can also complicate the relationship between expert assessment and professional interest.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A metric designed to summarize quality can become a target that reorganizes behavior.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book connects these incentives rather than treating each failure as an isolated scandal.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its reform question is who will do verification when doing it carries real costs.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The constructive chapters propose moving more assessment toward specific claims and their dependencies.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A person's reputation can remain useful without deciding every claim in advance.
